dogecoin.text: ElevenLabs snagging $250M for AI voice cloning? Guess we're one step closer to deepfaking reality itself—just wait till $DOGE starts narrating bedtime stories.
Big tech is dropping billions on AI like it's $DOGE in 2021. Wall Street's patience is thinner than $ETH gas fees during a bull run.
Nvidia just watched $500B vanish faster than a $DOGE meme pump after DeepSeek's AI flexed its muscles. Guess the green team learned that in the AI arms race, you either innovate or evaporate.
DeepSeek just dropped a bomb on US tech supremacy, and the ripple effect is shaking global stocks harder than a $DOGE tweet.
